details: Bitcoin experienced a significant drop in price, declining by 3.7% in the past 24 hours, after US Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh delivered a hawkish speech at Jackson Hole. This speech impacted a derivatives market already considered fragile, with approximately $6.4 billion in Bitcoin options expiring on Friday. Analysts noted that market positioning, particularly around the $75,000 to $80,000 strikes, showed a "classic tension state" with bullish long-term sentiment but fading momentum, making it vulnerable to hawkish signals.
title: Bitcoin Falls After Hawkish Fed Speech

details: Turkmenistan has legalized cryptocurrency mining and exchanges, marking a significant shift in the country's economic policy. President Serdar Berdimuhamedov signed legislation establishing a licensing scheme that will be overseen by the country's central bank.
title: Turkmenistan Legalizes Crypto Mining and Exchanges
